content:
sara: Quick ping — created PR #2384 to add streaming chunked responses to the Python SDK tool-calling path. Needs a review before EOD. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2384 :eyes:

matt: @sara I'll take a look in ~30m. Does it change public API or just internal streaming?

sara: internal only. public interface unchanged, just yields chunks from the server earlier. added full unit tests + integration check in CI.

jen: Linking tests now. failing on one case in test_toolcall_stream where final chunk is None. i'll post a small suggestion.

jen: suggestion: in stream_iterator() change

```
if chunk is None:
    break
```

to

```
if chunk is None:
    yield {'done': True}
    break
```

so downstream consumers get explicit completion event.

sara: ah good catch — I wanted graceful end. I'll push fix + add test.

ci-bot: CI run queued — python-3.10, lint, unit, integration.

matt: also check docs: bump changelog and add small note in streaming.md about tool-calls.

sara: added changelog entry and streaming.md note in same branch.

kevin: quick review done. small nits: 1) rename variable `resp` -> `chunk` 2) add type hint on stream_iterator -> Iterator[Dict[str, Any]]. Otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup: 

sara: pushing rename + type hints now.

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green. merging in 5m unless objections.

jen: no objections. go ahead.

matt: fine by me.

kevin: approved.

sara: merged, thanks everyone! :tada:
